HOW TO USE

Interactive controls

2D MAP — drag to pan, mouse-wheel or −/+ to zoom, coordinate readout follows the cursor, switch ramps and display range live.

3D TERRAIN — drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag to pan. Vertical exaggeration slider scales terrain relief.

LAYERS — Elevation · Hillshade · Slope · Local relief · Terrain ruggedness. Switching layers refetches the downsampled grid.
